implementation: A canonical game-created D3D11 Draw capture can contain separated authentic GPU RGB changes farther apart than the preselected 24x24 or 40px RAW display tile. Previously the NativeRawSourceIslandBatch repeatedly inspected only the chosen preview, dropping the other real game-dirty panel. Use the whole bounded pre/post GPU capture clipped to the genuine D3D9 Present crop, preserving exact staging source offset and original destination coordinates; the independent dirty RGNDATA and pixel-delta admission still happens before UpdateSurface. A compiled regression captures two separated 4x4 original-game RGB panels in one D3D11 Draw, recovering both 16-pixel source-owned uploads while rejecting alpha-only, mismatched target dimensions, out-of-bounds source capture, empty crop and forged D3D9 bound. RAW remains opt-in; no full-frame/Quest3 claim.
